Automations That Save Real Time

Here are the workflows I build most often for small business teams.

Form-to-Sheet Processing

Google Form submissions automatically parsed, validated, and routed to the right team members with formatted email notifications.

Saves 3-5 hrs/week

Approval Workflows

Multi-step approval chains triggered by form submissions or spreadsheet entries. Managers get email prompts; status updates automatically in Sheets.

Saves 4-6 hrs/week

Auto-Notifications & Reminders

Scheduled email or Chat alerts based on spreadsheet data — overdue tasks, expiring contracts, upcoming renewals, missing fields.

Weekly or monthly reports auto-generated from Sheets data and emailed as formatted PDFs or Google Docs to stakeholders.

Data Sync & Cleanup

Keep multiple Sheets in sync, deduplicate entries, format data consistently, and archive old records automatically on a schedule.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about the Automation Sprint.

Why Apps Script instead of Zapier or Make?

Apps Script runs natively inside Google Workspace — no third-party platform fees, no per-task pricing, and no data leaving Google's ecosystem. For most Workspace-centric workflows, it's faster, cheaper, and more reliable long-term. Read the full comparison on our blog.

What if my automation needs more than one workflow?

The Sprint is scoped to one workflow to keep timelines predictable. If you need multiple automations, we can run consecutive sprints or scope a custom engagement during the discovery call. Many clients start with one and add more after seeing the results.

Do I own the code?

Yes, 100%. The Apps Script code lives in your Google Workspace account. You get full documentation explaining how it works. There are no licensing fees, no vendor lock-in, and no recurring charges from me.

What happens if something breaks after 30 days?

The code is documented well enough for any Apps Script developer to maintain. If you want ongoing support, the Pro Support plan ($799/month) includes up to 8 hours of on-demand maintenance, fixes, and new features.
